title: Ele disse: "acabei o projeto". Que projeto?
concept: A real support chat told as a film in three chapters inside a 2.39:1 letterbox: 'Acabei o projeto', 47 minutes later 'qual projeto?', 15 minutes of silence, then the bars open and the answer lands as an evidence photo: 'Shiny tangela / E outros dois shinys eu peguei' = the project was 3 shinies.

music.note: muffled strings intro, break, build under the wait, silence, drop as the letterbox opens

claims: detecção de shinys, megas e bosses

notes: Concept said the support asked 'Que projeto?'; the print literally says 'qual projeto?', which is what is shown (print crop, verbatim). '47 minutos' and '15 minutos' are arithmetic on the print's visible timestamps (20:16 -> 21:03 -> 21:18). Hook quote trims 'kkk' from 'Acabei o projeto kkk'. '3 shinies' = shiny tangela + 'outros dois shinys'. No claim about how they were caught beyond 'Cliente KizuBot'. Source named in the concept as acabei-o-projeto.png; used the asset editor's acabei-o-projeto.png crops.
